learning_outcomes.text: is able to identify, formulate and develop the documentation of a simple design or technological task, including the description of the results of this task in Polish or in a foreign language and to present the results using computer software or other aiding tools
He is able to build, design and analyze basic automatic control systems with the typical, universal industrial controllers.

The student knows the structure of a typical automation system and its components. He is able to build, design and analyze basic automatic control systems with the typical, universal industrial controllers.

syllabus_topics: Classification and examples of control system elements
Basic information about digital control systems
Design, synthesis and analysis of digital control systems
Basic information about analog control systems
Method of description control systems, elements and signals
Construction, modeling and analysis of robot motion
The sensors used in industrial robots
Static and dynamic characteristics of control systems
Design of combinational and sequential logic circuits
Time and frequency characteristics of selected control system components
Programming of serial kinematics, industrial robot Nachi MZ04 and parallel, delta type kinematics robot ABB IRB 360
Programming of collaborative robot Hanwha HCR3a
assessment_rules: A passing threshold of 56.0% is required for the midterm colloquium, written exam, and laboratory reports.
